AddDisplayKnowledge.description_en: Synchronously adds content to a display knowledge base in batches
AddDisplayKnowledge.description_zh: 陈列知识库内容批量新增（同步）

AiTryOn.description_en: Generates virtual try-on images by applying specified garments to a model image based on AI algorithms. It preserves the model's pose, facial features, and background details while ensuring a realistic fit. Users can obtain the processed images by providing the URLs of the original product and model images
AiTryOn.description_zh: 虚拟试穿是一款基于AI算法的图像生成类API服务，能够依据用户输入的服装图和模特图，将服装替换模特现有服装，保有模特的其他细节和画面细节，不改变模特动作、面容等，且实现服装上身的合理性和适配性。用户只需传入原始商品图URL，即可获得处理后的干净图片

AssetOptimizeLite.description_en: Optimizes cross-platform product materials for cross-border e-commerce sellers with a one-click, cost-effective service. Takes a product link from a source platform and outputs a full set of materials, including titles, attributes, main images, SKU images, detail images, and copy, tailored to the target platform requirements. Uses an official pre-built, lowest-cost workflow that focuses on filtering and lightweight processing without invoking high-cost image translation capabilities, maximizing cost control while ensuring listing compliance. (Asynchronous)
AssetOptimizeLite.description_zh: 面向跨境电商卖家的跨平台商品素材一键优化服务（最低成本版）。输入货源平台商品链接，一键输出适配铺货平台要求的标题、属性、主图、SKU图、详情图与文案等全量素材。采用官方预制的最低成本流程，以过滤+轻量处理为主，不调用高成本的图片翻译能力，在保证上架合规性的前提下最大限度控制调用成本。（异步）

AssetOptimizePro.description_en: Provides a one-click cross-platform product material optimization service for cross-border e-commerce sellers (optimal performance edition). This asynchronous operation takes 1688 product links as input and generates a full set of materials tailored to TEMU platform requirements, including titles, attributes, main images, SKU images, detail images, and copy. It uses officially pre-configured optimal workflows to maximize AI capabilities, retains and localizes brand marketing materials, and generates personalized materials such as size charts for categories like apparel
AssetOptimizePro.description_zh: 面向跨境电商卖家的跨平台商品素材一键优化服务（最佳效果版）。输入1688商品链接，一键输出适配TEMU平台要求的标题、属性、主图、SKU图、详情图与文案等全量素材。采用官方预制的最好效果流程，最大化调用AI能力，保留并本地化品牌营销素材，并针对服饰等类目输出尺码表等个性化素材。（异步）

CategoryAttributeMatch.description_en: Provides an intelligent cross-platform product category attribute filling service based on multimodal large models. Accepts product information from a source platform, automatically matches the category on a target platform, and intelligently fills all required attribute fields under the category to provide a one-stop solution for category selection and attribute filling during product listing. (Synchronous)
CategoryAttributeMatch.description_zh: 基于多模态大模型的跨平台商品类目属性智能填写服务。输入货源平台的商品信息，自动匹配铺货平台的类目，并智能填写该类目下所有必填属性字段，一站式解决铺货时的类目选择与属性填写问题。（同步）

CategoryMatch.description_en: Provides an intelligent cross-platform product category matching service based on large language models. Accepts product information from a source platform, automatically matches the optimal category on the target platform, and returns a confidence score and matching rationale to help merchants quickly select categories for cross-platform product listing. (Synchronous)
CategoryMatch.description_zh: 基于大语言模型的跨平台商品类目智能匹配服务。输入货源平台的商品信息，自动匹配铺货平台的最佳匹配类目，并返回置信度评分与匹配理由，帮助商家快速完成跨平台铺货时的类目选择。（同步）

DeleteDisplayKnowledge.description_en: Synchronously deletes content from a display knowledge base in batches
DeleteDisplayKnowledge.description_zh: 陈列知识库内容批量删除（同步）

DiduiAreaDeduction.description_en: Calculates the side lengths and floor area of a floor display based on the floor display image and product bounding boxes
DiduiAreaDeduction.description_zh: 根据地堆图片和商品检测框，计算地堆边长及占地面积

DiduiAreaDeductionPro.description_en: Analyzes the area of floor displays based on product recognition, SKU asset knowledge bases, and dedicated area reasoning model building. The product first locates products in the floor display, reads the actual dimensions and reference images of the corresponding SKUs, and infers the side lengths and area of the bounding rectangle of the floor display. This feature is suitable for evaluating the scale of floor displays in stores and for inspection and review
DiduiAreaDeductionPro.description_zh: 基于商品识别、SKU 资产知识库和专用面积推理模型构建的地堆面积分析产品。产品先定位地堆商品，再读取对应 SKU 的真实长宽高与参考图，推理地堆占地外接矩形的两条边长及面积，适用于门店地堆陈列规模评估与巡检复核

DocumentTranslate.description_en:
Translates documents with a solution designed specifically for document translation. It supports over 150 languages and provides pivot translation capabilities with thousands of pivot combinations. It handles multi-scenario, multi-page, and highly complex document translation, but does not currently support scanned documents. It excels in the following aspects:
Content accuracy: translation accuracy, and accuracy of parameters and units.
Structural integrity: overall layout continuity, and restoration of page margins and layouts
DocumentTranslate.description_zh:
专为文档翻译研发，支持150多个语言的翻译，并提供了桥接翻译能力，多达数千种桥接组合。满足多场景&多页数&高复杂度文档翻译，暂不支持扫描件。
在以下方面表现出色：
· 内容准确性：翻译准确性，参数与单位准确性
· 结构合理性：整体排版连续性，页面边距与布局还原性

EcomVideoRecreation.description_en: E-commerce video replication is an AI video service designed for product content production, covering video understanding, element replacement, quality verification, and result delivery. The service focuses on product and person consistency, detail restoration, conversion expression, and scaled production. It supports targeted replacement of products or persons based on viral video templates. By preserving the original actions, camera pacing, and marketing structure, it rapidly generates multiple content versions to reduce shooting, editing, and adaptation costs
EcomVideoRecreation.description_zh: 电商视频裂变是一套面向商品内容生产的 AI 视频服务，覆盖视频理解、元素替换、质量校验和结果交付。产品聚焦商品与人物一致性、细节还原、转化表达和规模化生产，支持基于爆款视频母版定向替换商品或人物，在保留原有动作、镜头节奏和营销结构的基础上，快速生成多版本内容，降低拍摄、剪辑和适配成本

GeneralRephotographyDetection.description_en: Detects whether an image is recaptured and localizes main physical products, screen display areas, printed photos, and visible recapture clues based on recapture recognition and multimodal large model element localization. It is suitable for risk screening and manual review of store inspection photos across multiple categories
GeneralRephotographyDetection.description_zh: 基于翻拍识别能力与多模态大模型元素定位构建的通用图片审核产品。产品判断图片是否翻拍，并定位主要实物商品、屏幕显示区、打印照片及可见翻拍线索，适用于多品类门店巡检照片的风险筛查与人工审核

GenerateProductContent.description_en: Generates or rewrites e-commerce product copy, including titles, short highlights, search keywords, bullet points, and product descriptions, based on product information or existing copy. Adapts the content type and length to the requirements of the target platform. Supports Chinese and English input materials and optional multilingual translation, making it suitable for domestic product listing, cross-border product distribution, and product copy localization. Uses synchronous calls and processes one copy type for one product per request
GenerateProductContent.description_zh:
商品文案生成是面向电商商品内容生产的 AI 文本服务。输入商品资料或已有文案，即可生成或改写商品标题、短亮点、搜索关键词、分点卖点及商品描述，并按需适配目标平台的内容类型和长度要求。
支持中文、英文素材输入，以及可选的多语言翻译，适用于国内商品上架、跨境铺货和商品文案本地化等场景。接口采用同步调用方式，每次请求处理一个商品的一种文案类型

ImageCropping.description_en: Intelligently crops images to specified sizes by automatically identifying the main subject area and precisely cropping them to various sizes to meet design requirements across different scenarios. (Synchronous)
ImageCropping.description_zh: 按照指定尺寸智能裁剪图片，自动识别图片主体区域，精准裁剪出各类尺寸，适配各种场景的设计需求。（同步）

ImageMatting.description_en: Identifies the salient subject in an image, separates the subject from the background, and returns the subject image with the background removed. This feature also provides multiple background options and custom size options to optimize product display effects. (Synchronous)
ImageMatting.description_zh: 智能抠图产品可以自动识别图像中的显著性主体，将主体和背景进行分离，返回去除背景后的主体图片。同时该产品还提供多种背景选项及定制尺寸选择，优化商品展示效果。（同步）

ImageMattingAsync.description_en: Extracts the salient subject from an image by automatically identifying and separating it from the background, and returns the subject image with the background removed. This operation also provides multiple background options and custom size selections to optimize product display
ImageMattingAsync.description_zh: 智能抠图产品可以自动识别图像中的显著性主体，将主体和背景进行分离，返回去除背景后的主体图片。同时该产品还提供多种背景选项及定制尺寸选择，优化商品展示效果

ImageRecognition.description_en: Identifies specific elements in e-commerce images

ImageRecognitionAsync.description_en: Identifies specific elements in e-commerce images. It deeply analyzes image details to help users quickly identify elements such as text, logos, watermarks, and text-containing color blocks in the main subject and background, significantly improving the efficiency and accuracy of image filtering
ImageRecognitionAsync.description_zh: 智能元素识别API是专为电商图像特定元素识别而设计的API。它能够深入挖掘图像中的细节，帮助用户快速识别图片主体和背景中的文字、Logo、水印及含字色块等元素，能极大提升图像筛选的效率和准确性

ImageRemovalPro.description_en: Intelligently removes unwanted elements from e-commerce images. Tailored for e-commerce scenarios, it automatically identifies and removes text, specific names, transparent text blocks, and watermarks. You can specify objects to remove on demand to efficiently and accurately process large image batches and simplify image editing in synchronous or asynchronous mode
ImageRemovalPro.description_zh: 图像智能消除产品专为电商图片定制，自动识别并消除电商图片中的文字、特定名称、透明字块和牛皮癣，可按需指定消除图片内对象，实现大批量图片的高效、精确处理，简化图片编辑工作（同步/异步）

ImageRemovalProAsync.description_en: Removes text, specific names, transparent text blocks, and promotional watermarks from e-commerce images. This operation automatically identifies and removes these elements or allows you to specify the objects to be removed, enabling efficient and accurate processing of large batches of images and simplifying image editing
ImageRemovalProAsync.description_zh: 图像智能消除产品专为电商图片定制，自动识别并消除电商图片中的文字、特定名称、透明字块和牛皮癣，可按需指定消除图片内对象，实现大批量图片的高效、精确处理，简化图片编辑工作

ImageRemove.description_en: Intelligently removes unwanted elements from e-commerce images. This product automatically identifies and removes text, specific names, transparent text blocks, and image blemishes from e-commerce images. You can specify objects to remove as needed, enabling efficient and precise batch processing of large volumes of images and simplifying image editing workflows. (Synchronous)
ImageRemove.description_zh: 图像智能消除产品专为电商图片定制，自动识别并消除电商图片中的文字、特定名称、透明字块和牛皮癣，可按需指定消除图片内对象，实现大批量图片的高效、精确处理，简化图片编辑工作。（同步）

ImageRemoveAsync.description_en: Intelligently removes unwanted elements from e-commerce images by automatically identifying and erasing text, specific names, transparent text blocks, and intrusive watermarks. It also allows you to specify objects for removal as needed, enabling efficient and accurate processing of large image batches and simplifying image editing workflows
ImageRemoveAsync.description_zh: 图像智能消除产品专为电商图片定制，自动识别并消除电商图片中的文字、特定名称、透明字块和牛皮癣，可按需指定消除图片内对象，实现大批量图片的高效、精确处理，简化图片编辑工作

ImageTranslationPlus.description_en: Translates e-commerce images by using the PLUS edition of the image translation service. Built on the Mixture of Experts (MOE) architecture, this edition delivers higher translation accuracy for multiple minor languages than the Lite and Pro editions. It is recommended for the following 12 language pairs, with more to be added in the future
ImageTranslationPlus.description_zh: 图片翻译PLUS版产品专为电商图片设计，采用MOE架构，相比于图片翻译lite版和Pro版，在多个小语种的翻译准确性上表现更胜一筹，建议您在以下12个语向上进行使用，后续会拓展更多语向

ImageTranslationPlusAsync.description_en: Image Translation Plus is designed specifically for e-commerce images. It adopts the Mixture of Experts (MoE) architecture and outperforms Image Translation Lite and Pro in translation accuracy for multiple minor languages
ImageTranslationPlusAsync.description_zh: 图片翻译Plus版产品专为电商图片设计，采用MOE架构，相比于图片翻译lite版和Pro版，在多个小语种的翻译准确性上表现更胜一筹

ImageTranslationPro.description_en: Translates e-commerce images by using the Pro edition of the image translation service. Integrates multimodal large models to achieve more accurate image understanding, significantly improves translation quality, and continuously expands and optimizes multilingual translation capabilities. Supports over 400 language pairs, including bridged languages
ImageTranslationPro.description_zh: 图片翻译Pro版产品专为电商图片设计，融合多模态大模型技术，实现对图片的更精准理解，显著提高翻译质量，并不断扩展和优化多语言翻译能力。支持400多种(含桥接)语向

ImageTranslationProAsync.description_en: Translates images by using Image Translation Pro, which is designed specifically for e-commerce images, integrates multimodal large model technology for more accurate image understanding, significantly improves translation quality, and continuously expands and optimizes multilingual translation capabilities. It supports more than 400 language pairs, including bridged languages
ImageTranslationProAsync.description_zh: 图片翻译Pro版产品专为电商图片设计，融合多模态大模型技术，实现对图片的更精准理解，显著提高翻译质量，并不断扩展和优化多语言翻译能力。支持400多种语向(含桥接)

ImageTranslationStandard.description_en: Translates e-commerce images and supports over 400 language pairs, including bridged languages. Accurately processes complex text layouts within images and ensures that the translated content matches the image context, helping e-commerce platforms and developers easily achieve multilingual conversion and presentation of image content. Additionally, returns layer information such as the position, font, and color of text in the image to facilitate secondary editing of translation results in image editors
ImageTranslationStandard.description_zh: 图片翻译产品专为电商图片定制，支持 400 多种语向（含桥接），精确处理图片内的复杂文本布局，并确保翻译内容能够与图片内容匹配，帮助电商平台和开发者轻松实现图像内容的多语言转换与呈现。同时，产品支持返回图片中文字的位置、字体、颜色等图层信息，便于接入图片编辑器对翻译结果进行二次编辑

ImageTranslationStandardAsync.description_en: Translates images tailored for e-commerce scenarios, supporting over 400 language directions (including bridged languages), accurately processing complex text layouts within images, and ensuring translated content matches the image context to help e-commerce platforms and developers easily achieve multilingual conversion and presentation of image content. It also returns layer information such as text position, font, and color to facilitate secondary editing of translation results in image editors
ImageTranslationStandardAsync.description_zh: 图片翻译产品专为电商图片定制，支持 400 多种语向（含桥接），精确处理图片内的复杂文本布局，并确保翻译内容能够与图片内容匹配，帮助电商平台和开发者轻松实现图像内容的多语言转换与呈现。同时，产品支持返回图片中文字的位置、字体、颜色等图层信息，便于接入图片编辑器对翻译结果进行二次编辑

ImageUpscale.description_en: Upscales e-commerce images by intelligently enhancing resolution and details, improving textures and image quality during the upscaling process. Supports high-definition outputs such as 2K and 4K to meet the requirements for product main images, detail images, and marketing materials, and enables efficient processing of large batches of images to improve overall image quality. (Synchronous)
ImageUpscale.description_zh: 高清放大产品专为电商图片定制，智能提升图片分辨率与细节表现，在放大过程中增强纹理、优化画质，支持 2K、4K 等高清输出，满足商品主图、细节图及营销素材的高清化需求，实现大批量图片的高效、清晰处理，提升商品图片质量。（同步）

LanguageDetect.description_en: Supports automatic language identification for 31 languages in query scenarios and 35 languages in general scenarios. Applicable to short text such as search terms, titles, and conversations
LanguageDetect.description_zh: 支持Query31 个语种，通用场景 35 个语种的自动识别，适用于搜索词，标题，会话这类短文本语种的识别

MaterialInspection.description_en: Material display detection is an intelligent compliance detection capability for in-store marketing materials built on a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM), designed for marketing material inspection scenarios in offline retail and channel stores. For standard materials such as functional card stands, posters, and door-shaped display stands, as well as long-tail materials such as light cloth banners, KT boards, floor stickers, and light boxes captured in store photos, the service performs natural-language-level compliance checks based on inspection rules and outputs structured conclusions and evidence descriptions that can be directly integrated with business systems. This is a synchronous call that returns results in a single request
MaterialInspection.description_zh: 物料陈列检测是基于多模态大模型（MLLM）构建的门店营销物料合规智能检测能力，面向线下零售 / 渠道门店的营销物料巡检场景。针对门店实拍图中的功能台卡、海报、门型展架等标准物料，以及灯布、KT 板、地贴、灯箱等长尾物料，按巡检规则做自然语言级合规判定，输出可直接对接业务系统的结构化结论与中文证据描述。同步调用，单次请求即返回结果

MerchandisePlacementDetection.description_en: Detects and identifies products displayed on store shelves or floor stacks by using a multimodal large language model (MLLM) combined with visual vector recall. The service is designed for shelf and floor stack inspection scenarios in offline retail and channel stores. It first uses the MLLM to detect the bounding box and preliminary name of each product in a store photo, then performs similarity recall against a customer-specific SKU vector library to exactly match each product to the customer's own SKUs, and outputs per-product structured results that can be directly integrated with business systems. This service is suitable for large-scale, high-concurrent visual recognition pipelines such as remote display auditing by headquarters, SKU distribution verification, and display compliance inspection for offline stores
MerchandisePlacementDetection.description_zh: 陈列检测是基于多模态大模型（MLLM）+ 视觉向量召回构建的门店商品陈列智能识别能力，面向线下零售 / 渠道门店的货架 / 地堆陈列巡检场景。产品对门店实拍的货架图、地堆图，先用多模态大模型检测出每个商品的边界框与初步名称，再以客户专属 SKU 向量库做相似度召回，把每个商品精确匹配到客户自有的 SKU，输出可直接对接业务系统的逐商品结构化结果。适用于总部对线下门店陈列的远程稽核、SKU 铺货核验、陈列合规巡检等大规模、高并发的视觉识别流水线

MerchandisePlacementDetectionLite.description_en: Detects product displays in photos of shelves, endcaps, freezers, display tables, and dump bins by using product SKU recognition and multimodal large model grounding. It aggregates product locations by SKU and supplements the results with visible single-item grounding and short names to facilitate product location display, display inventory, and subsequent distribution verification in business systems
MerchandisePlacementDetectionLite.description_zh: 基于商品 SKU 识别与多模态大模型定位构建的轻量陈列检测产品，面向货架、端架、冰柜、陈列台和堆头照片。产品按 SKU 汇总商品位置，并补充可见单品定位与短名称，便于业务系统开展商品位置展示、陈列盘点和后续铺货核验

MerchandisePlacementDetectionPro.description_en: Detects the positions and names of visible products in an image based on a dedicated visual model. The product supports default recognition rules for the Genki Forest business type and custom rules provided by the invoker. It outputs per-product positions and names, applicable to beverage display inspection and product location display
MerchandisePlacementDetectionPro.description_zh: 基于专用视觉模型构建的商品陈列检测产品，直接识别图片中可见商品的位置和名称。产品支持元气森林业务类型的默认识别规则，也支持调用方提供自定义规则，输出逐商品位置与名称，适用于饮料陈列巡检和商品定位展示

MerchandisePriceTagDetection.description_en: Detects display price tags based on price tag recognition and multimodal large model localization, extracting product information, selling prices, original prices, and locations, while providing visible bounding boxes for paper price tags, electronic price tags, and promotional price signs for store price collection, price tag inspection, and business-side price verification
MerchandisePriceTagDetection.description_zh: 基于价签识别与多模态大模型定位构建的陈列价签检测产品。产品提取价签对应的商品信息、售价、原价及位置，并补充纸质价签、电子价签和促销价格牌的可见框，适用于门店价格采集、价签巡检与业务侧价格核对

MerchandiseSceneDetection.description_en: Detects store displays based on display scene recognition and holistic positioning powered by multimodal large models. This product identifies display areas such as shelves, refrigerators, and floor displays, and outputs available scene names, locations, and display metrics. It also provides overall facility bounding boxes, making it suitable for display facility inspection, area visualization, and display metric verification
MerchandiseSceneDetection.description_zh: 基于陈列场景识别与多模态大模型整体定位构建的门店陈列检测产品。产品识别货架、冷柜、地堆等陈列区域，输出可用的场景名称、位置和陈列指标，并补充设施整体框，适用于陈列设施巡检、区域展示和陈列指标复核

MilkPowderCanBottomCodeRephotographyDete.description_en: Reviews images of milk powder can bottom codes by using recapture detection and multimodal large model-based element localization. The service determines whether an uploaded photo is recaptured and localizes visible milk powder products, can bottoms, and bottom code areas. It is suitable for milk powder channel inspections, can bottom code photo reviews, and manual verifications
MilkPowderCanBottomCodeRephotographyDete.description_zh: 基于翻拍识别能力与多模态大模型元素定位构建的奶粉罐底码图片审核产品。产品判断上传照片是否翻拍，并定位可见奶粉商品、罐底及底码区域，适用于奶粉渠道巡检、罐底码照片审核及人工复核

MilkPowderCartonCodeRephotographyDetecti.description_en: Reviews infant formula carton code images based on recapture detection and element localization using multimodal foundation models. It targets photos of infant formula products, outer cartons, and carton codes captured during channel inspections. It determines whether images are non-recaptured, recaptured, or suspected recaptures, and localizes visible infant formula products, outer cartons, and code regions to provide a structured basis for image review and manual verification
MilkPowderCartonCodeRephotographyDetecti.description_zh: 基于翻拍识别能力与多模态大模型元素定位构建的奶粉箱码图片审核产品，面向渠道巡检中的奶粉商品、外箱及箱码照片。产品输出非翻拍、翻拍或疑似翻拍结论，并定位可见奶粉商品、外箱与码区，为照片审核和人工复核提供结构化依据

PackageWeightSizeCheck.description_en: An intelligent logistics parcel review product built on the collaboration of a multimodal large language model (MLLM) and dedicated vision algorithms. It targets automated compliance review for the "piece-weight-dimension" stage in e-commerce logistics. The product performs structured review across multiple dimensions, including bounding box validity, bounding box fit, and foreign object interference for parcels on scanning platforms. It supports different hardware capture scenarios such as white and green background boards, and outputs Boolean review conclusions with Chinese-language reason descriptions that can be directly integrated with business systems. It is suitable for large-scale, high-concurrency inbound quality inspection pipelines
PackageWeightSizeCheck.description_zh: 基于多模态大模型(MLLM)与专用视觉算法协同构建的物流包裹智能审核产品,面向电商物流"件重尺"环节的合规性自动复核场景。产品针对扫描平台上包裹的框选有效性、框选贴合度、异物干扰等多个维度进行结构化审核,可同时适配白色背景板、绿色背景板等不同硬件采集场景,输出可直接对接业务系统的布尔型审核结论与中文原因描述,适用于大规模、高并发的入库质检流水线

PrepaidTextTranslate.description_en: Maas-MT is an e-commerce translation model trained on over 1 billion high-quality bilingual sentence pairs, continuously optimized for e-commerce-specific terminology such as brands, models, materials, and attributes. It supports mutual translation among more than 400 language directions (including bridged translations), especially Chinese-English, Chinese-to-multilingual, and English-to-multilingual translations. It supports language detection for 24 language directions. If you do not specify a source language, automatic detection is performed
PrepaidTextTranslate.description_zh: Maas-MT是10亿+ 高质量双语句对训练出的电商领域翻译模型，针对电商领域特有的品牌、型号、材质、属性等术语进行不断优化。支持400多种(含桥接)语向间的互译，尤其是中英互译、中文与多语言的互译，英文与多语言的互译。支持 24 个语向的语种识别，如您不设置源语言可实现自动识别

ProductHotspotDetection.description_en: Automatically identifies and locates specified products in an image based on a multimodal foundation model
ProductHotspotDetection.description_zh: 基于多模态大模型自动识别并定位图片中的指定商品

ProductVideoGeneration.description_en: Generates a single-product showcase video by using the E-commerce Video Basic Edition. Based on a product title, multiple images of the same product, and an optional storyboard script, the API automatically selects reference images, plans a three-shot storyboard, and generates the video. This API uses asynchronous tasks, supports 720p and 1080p resolutions and four aspect ratios, and applies to product content production for non-apparel categories. For apparel categories, use the E-commerce Video Enhanced Edition
ProductVideoGeneration.description_zh: 电商视频基础版面向电商商家与平台，根据商品标题、同一商品的多张图片，可选输入分镜脚本，自动选择参考图、规划三段分镜并生成单商品展示视频。接口采用异步任务方式，支持 720P、1080P 分辨率和四种画幅，适用于非服饰类目的商品内容生产。服饰类目使用电商增强版

QueryAsyncTaskResult.description_en: Queries the result of an asynchronous task. The API name in the POP gateway is QueryAsyncTaskResult

QueryDisplayKnowledge.description_en: Queries the display knowledge base content by using a paged query with paging (synchronization)
QueryDisplayKnowledge.description_zh: 陈列知识库内容分页查询（同步）

SizeChartDetect.description_en: Detects whether an image contains a size chart. (Synchronous)
SizeChartDetect.description_zh: 检测图片中是否含有尺码图。（同步）

SizeChartExtract.description_en: Intelligently extracts structured information such as size charts and package weight/dimension data from images by using a multimodal large language model. (Asynchronous)
SizeChartExtract.description_zh: 通过多模态大模型智能提取图片中的尺码图、件重尺等结构化信息。（异步）

SizeChartExtractAsync.description_en: Extracts structured information such as size charts and item weight and dimensions from images by using a multimodal large model. (Asynchronous)
SizeChartExtractAsync.description_zh: 通过多模态大模型智能提取图片中的尺码图、件重尺等结构化信息。（异步）

StorefrontSceneRecognition.description_en: Reviews store photos based on storefront scene recognition and multimodal large model element localization. It outputs storefront scene classifications and confidence details, and localizes storefronts, signboards, entrances, and business signs. It is applicable to store data collection, storefront photo classification, and inspection reviews
StorefrontSceneRecognition.description_zh: 基于店头场景识别与多模态大模型元素定位构建的门店照片审核产品。产品输出店头场景分类及可用置信度明细，同时定位店面、店招、入口和营业标识，适用于门店资料采集、店头照片分类与巡检复核

SubmitProductMatch.description_en: Generates product detail page assets automatically based on a multimodal large language model (MLLM) and structured image-text extraction, designed for product detail page asset completion scenarios on e-commerce platforms and for brand merchants. The caller pushes product information to be queried (product ID, title, brand, main image, and shop name). The service automatically locates matching products and performs consistency verification, then extracts size information and product attributes from the matching product details, and renders them into size charts and attribute charts (SVG) that can be directly used on detail pages. The service also returns structured detail copy classifications and processing notes
SubmitProductMatch.description_zh: 基于多模态大模型（MLLM）+ 图文结构化抽取构建的商品详情素材自动生成产品，面向电商平台 / 品牌商的商品详情页素材补齐场景。调用方推送待查询商品信息（商品 ID、标题、品牌、主图、店铺名），产品自动定位其同款商品并做一致性校验，再从同款商品详情中抽取尺码信息与商品属性，渲染为可直接用于详情页的尺码图与属性图（SVG），同时返回结构化的详情文案分类与处理备注

TextCorrect.description_en: Corrects errors in search terms and titles
TextCorrect.description_zh: 针对搜索词及标题进行纠错修改

TextTranslate.description_en: Maas-MT is an e-commerce translation model trained on over 1 billion high-quality bilingual sentence pairs, with continuous optimization for e-commerce-specific terminology such as brands, models, materials, and attributes. It supports mutual translation among more than 400 language directions (including bridged directions), especially Chinese-English, Chinese-multilingual, and English-multilingual translation. It supports language detection for query phrases in 31 languages and general scenarios in 35 languages. If you do not specify a source language, automatic detection is performed
TextTranslate.description_zh: Maas-MT是10亿+ 高质量双语句对训练出的电商领域翻译模型，针对电商领域特有的品牌、型号、材质、属性等术语进行不断优化。支持400多种(含桥接)语向间的互译，尤其是中英互译、中文与多语言的互译，英文与多语言的互译。支持 Query 短语31 种语言和通用场景35 种语言的语向识别，如您不设置源语言可实现自动识别

TextTranslateAsync.description_en: Translates text by using the Maas MT e-commerce translation model, which is trained on over 1 billion high-quality bilingual sentence pairs and optimized for e-commerce terms such as brands, models, materials, and attributes. It supports 156 languages, over 400 language pairs, and automatic source language detection
TextTranslateAsync.description_zh: Maas MT是10亿+ 高质量双语句对训练出的电商领域翻译模型，针对电商领域特有的品牌、型号、材质、属性等术语进行不断优化。支持156种语言，累计400多映射关系，并在原始语向上支持自动识别

UpdateDisplayKnowledge.description_en: Synchronously modifies the content of a display knowledge base in batches
UpdateDisplayKnowledge.description_zh: 陈列知识库内容批量修改（同步）

VideoGeneration.description_en: The e-commerce AI video generation agent is designed for e-commerce merchants and platforms. Based on product main images, titles, and selling points, it automatically generates 5- to 30-second product showcase short videos to help customers efficiently produce and distribute e-commerce content. The product supports multiple resolution outputs such as 720P and 1080P. You can invoke single products quickly and generate multiple products in batches, meeting the needs of daily operations and large-scale product content production. It currently overwrites all clothing categories (tops, pants, skirts, suits, underwear, swimwear, etc.) and is gradually expanding to core e-commerce categories such as skincare, cosmetics, food and beverages, and home appliances
VideoGeneration.description_zh: 电商AI视频生成Agent面向电商商家与平台，基于商品主图、标题、卖点等信息，自动生成 5–30 秒商品展示短视频，帮助客户高效完成电商内容生产与分发。产品支持 720P、1080P 等多种清晰度输出，支持单商品快速调用与多商品批量生成，兼顾日常运营和大规模商品内容生产需求。当前已覆盖服饰全品类（上衣、裤装、裙装、套装、内衣、泳装等），逐步拓展至护肤品、化妆品、食品饮料、家用电器等电商核心类目

VideoTranslation.description_en: Translates the speech and on-screen text in a video into a target language. You can select speech subtitle translation, on-screen text translation, or both. This API applies to scenarios such as multilingual distribution of e-commerce videos, international social media marketing, and global brand advertising. The API uses an asynchronous invocation mode. After you submit a translation task, you can obtain the task ID and poll the task status by calling the query API until the task is completed and the result is returned
VideoTranslation.description_zh:
视频翻译 API 支持将视频中的语音和画面文字翻译为目标语言。您可以单独选择语音字幕翻译、画面文字翻译，或同时选择两种能力。适用于电商视频多语言分发、国际社交媒体营销、全球品牌广告投放等场景。
API 采用异步调用模式：提交翻译任务后获取 TaskId，通过查询接口轮询任务状态直至完成后获取结果

VirtualTryOn.description_en: Generates virtual try-on images by replacing the clothing on a model with a specified garment based on AI algorithms. The service preserves the model's pose, facial features, and background details while ensuring a realistic fit. You can obtain the processed image by providing the URLs of the original model and garment images
VirtualTryOn.description_zh: 虚拟试穿是一款基于AI算法的图像生成类API服务，能够依据用户输入的服装图和模特图，将服装替换模特现有服装，保有模特的其他细节和画面细节，不改变模特动作、面容等，且实现服装上身的合理性和适配性。用户只需传入原始商品图URL，即可获得处理后的干净图片

VisionFlow.description_en: Provides a one-stop AI image processing service for e-commerce sellers. Orchestrates six atomic capabilities—element recognition, intelligent cutout, intelligent erasure, image translation Pro, intelligent cropping, and high-definition upscaling—into an image processing workflow. Users can upload an image once, select the required capabilities, and complete multiple image optimizations in sequence to output product images that meet the requirements of e-commerce platforms. (Asynchronous)
VisionFlow.description_zh: 面向电商卖家的一站式 AI 图片智能处理服务。将元素识别、智能抠图、智能消除、图片翻译 Pro、智能裁剪、高清放大六项原子能力编排为图片处理工作流，用户只需一次上传图片、勾选所需能力，即可按顺序一次性完成多项图片优化，输出符合铺货平台要求的商品图。（异步）
